leave.title: Annual leave
leave.answer: Full-time employees receive 18 paid leave days per calendar year. Leave should be requested in advance through the HR system and approved by the manager. Unused days expire at year end unless local law or an approved exception applies.

remote_work.title: Remote and hybrid work
remote_work.answer: Teams may work remotely up to two days per week with manager approval. Customer-facing or onboarding activities may require on-site attendance. Employees should keep their calendars and status current.

holidays.title: Company holidays
holidays.answer: The company publishes its holiday calendar at the start of each year. Regional holidays are assigned according to the employee's work location. Check the HR system for the current calendar.

benefits.title: Benefits
benefits.answer: Benefits eligibility and enrollment details are maintained in the HR system. HR can confirm coverage, effective dates, and qualifying-life-event rules for an individual employee.
